_comment: Report definition for the clients listing, scoped by the caller's role. Insert into the 'reports' collection of the primary mongo database (application.json -> mongo.database / mongo.report_table, i.e. blueasset.reports). The 'clients' script (scripts/clients.go, interpreted via yaegi at request time -- see handlers/scriptrunner.go) reads 'clients' from the 'broker_portal' connection (same one record_of_advice_report.json uses for clients/advisors/brokerages). advisor_id (optional) scopes to one advisor's clients; principal_id (optional, not a declared parameter -- broker-portal injects it as a hidden field alongside an 'All' advisor_id selection) scopes to every client under advisors reporting to that principal. Neither set = every client (ADMIN 'All'). GET /run?name=clients[&advisor_id=<hex>][&principal_id=<hex>][&type=csv].
name: clients
description: Clients, optionally scoped to one advisor or a principal's book.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Optional client status shown in the report header (ACTIVE / ARCHIVED). Display only.

parameters.name: advisor_id
parameters.description: Scope to one advisor's clients. Rendered by broker-portal as a role-scoped picker (with an 'All' option), not a free-text field.
